== English errata comparison sources ==
The correction applies to both printed panels of this Light Side site. Its Dark Side twin has different Force icons and its own comparison.

* Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 28. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=28 Internet Archive].
* Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=27|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 27.
* Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=107|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 107.
